what: Core data model: the canonical formula
title: CLAUDE.md
text: Nearly every function package accepts data via formula form: Z must binary (0/1) treatment assignment; clusterID randomized unit (e.g., school); blockID optional stratum. deconstruct_var_formula() (R/helper_functions.R) parses . make_canonical_data() converts input (formula+data, formula whose LHS already data frame) canonical internal data frame fixed column names Yobs, Z, clusterID, blockID (control covariates appended -) — nearly internal estimator functions take formula = NULL operate directly canonical data rather re-parsing user formula. adding new estimator function, follow pattern: accept formula/data/control_formula, call make_canonical_data() top, operate canonical columns. Control covariates passed separately via control_formula (e.g. ~ X1 + X2, LHS); deconstruct_control_formula() validates don’t collide reserved names Y, Z, clusterID, blockID.
code: Yobs ~ Z | clusterID          # unblocked Yobs ~ Z | clusterID | blockID  # blocked (randomization blocks nested in blockID)

title: CLAUDE.md
text: compare_methods() (R/compare_methods.R) main entry point: given formula/data, calls estimator family, row-binds results, returns one data frame point estimate + SE per method. family lives file independently callable: R/linear_model_estimators.R — OLS-based estimators: LR (person-weighted linear regression), AR (aggregated/cluster-weighted regression); interacted_linear_model_estimators adds block--treatment interactions blocked designs. R/helper_interacted_estimators.R — shared machinery combining block-level interacted estimates overall ATE (generate_all_interacted_estimates, precision weighting via calc_agg_estimate, Welch-Satterthwaite df). R/aggregation_estimators.R — estimators run cluster-aggregated data (see aggregate_data()). R/design_based_estimators.R — DB_HT / DB_Raj design-based estimators following Schochet, Pashley, Miratrix & Kautz (JASA), plus Middleton & Aronow Raj-type estimator. R/MDStdCRT_estimator.R — MRStdCRT standardization-based estimator (see also standalone MRStdCRT/ trial_of_MRStdCRT.R exploratory area repo root, yet integrated package proper). R/MLM_model_estimators.R — multilevel/mixed-effects model (MLM) estimators via lme4/lmerTest, fixed-effect (FE), random-intercept (RE), fixed/random-interaction (FIRC/RIRC) block-handling variants. R/gee_estimators.R — GEE estimators via geepack. R/canonical_weight_esimators.R — canonical-weighting estimators (note filename typo — ’s esimators.R, estimators.R). Method names encode configuration dash-separated suffixes, e.g. LR-FIcw-db = linear regression, fixed-intercept--cluster-weighted block handling, design-based SEs. method_characteristics() canonical lookup table every implemented method name properties (regression weighting scheme — Person vs. Cluster — whether ’s biased, whether requires blocking, whether ’s “disfavored” due odd weighting/instability). get_estimand() looks target estimand (population weighting) given method name. adding new method variant, register name/characteristics method_characteristics() (R/compare_methods.R) flows get_estimand() reporting filters include_disfavored.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: R/describe_clusterRCT.R — describe_clusterRCT() summarizes structural characteristics dataset (block/cluster sizes, ICCs via calc_ICCs(), nesting via is_nested()); returns clusterRCTstats S3 object print/.data.frame methods. R/patch_data_set.R — patch_data_set() handles missing data (mean-imputation dummy flags) patch_singleton_blocks() handles blocks/clusters variation treatment (-treated -control), break variance estimation; compare_methods()’s handle_singleton_blocks argument ("drop"/"pool"/"fail") controls . R/rerandomize_simulation_code.R — rerandomize() re-simulates randomization (respecting cluster/block structure) randomization-inference-style simulation studies; run_rerandomize_simulation() / summarize_simulation_results() drive Monte Carlo comparisons estimators known ground truth. Test data: fakeCRT, fakeCRT2, fakeBrokeCRT (data/, generated via data-raw/fakeCRT.R using PUMP package) 3-level (student--school--district) simulated datasets used throughout tests vignette; fakeBrokeCRT intentionally missing data singleton blocks exercise patching logic.

title: ATE Estimation for Cluster Randomized Trials
text: clusterRCT provides easy means run collection different estimators estimate average treatment effects blocked, cluster randomized trials (trials randomization blocks, within block clusters randomized treatment control). also provides methods exploring data blocked, clustered structure. package also can used simple cluster-randomized trials blocking. Core methods compare_methods() compares estimates collection different estimation strategies given dataset, describe_clusterRCT() describes overall characteristics given dataset. package designed support paper, “Applied Researcher’s Guide Estimating Effects Multisite Cluster Randomized Trials: Estimands, Estimators, Estimates,” accepted JREE 2026. replication files paper, see replication GitHub. set code heavily uses package implemented simulations empirical data analyses.
